description: Closes, or reopens with undo true, one of YOUR OWN open feedback items from What's New 'Being worked on' (feedback_id, from read the open feedback items), as Done on your own item does. A repeat of the same idempotency_key returns the first result; marking an item already Done is refused. Another person's item is refused. Nothing is sent.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: mark_my_feedback_done
title: Mark your own feedback item done
